assumptions: envelope_length_x is 153.0, not the 150.0 in params.json: the connector land stands 3.0 mm proud of the +X face. Bounding boxes measure the artifact, not the intent.
The volume band is a sanity band, not a drawing requirement, so it is soft. Recompute it with `make spec-init` whenever the geometry changes.

design.role is `enclosure` because the part is a housing and every exterior face is a product surface. It is also the strictest rubric, which is why it is the safe thing to inherit: change it only when the part you build here genuinely is not a housing, and write the reason in DESIGN.md. See DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md section 2.1.
design.min_score 70 is the repo bar from DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md. Writing it is what makes the check HARD - delete it and the review still runs, but only warns.
